summary: Keep page identity, navigation and a few relevant actions together at the top of a view.

useWhen.text: Keep page identity, navigation and a few relevant actions together at the top of a view.

from.quote: Keep page identity, navigation and a few relevant actions together at the top of a view.

anatomy.holds: The leadingSlot: back or a product mark, such as JioDot, that establishes where the page sits in the flow.

from.quote: Back or a product mark establishes where the page sits in the flow.

anatomy.holds: The middleSlot: on a sub page, the title, centered inside the 192px middle slot.

from.quote: The SubPage title stays centered inside the 192px middle slot.

anatomy.holds: The actionsSlot: a small set of public actions that support the current page.

from.quote: Use a small set of public actions that support the current page.

placementAdvice.text: Place the App Bar at the top of a view.

from.quote: at the top of a view

placementAdvice.text: The host sets the available width; AppBar derives its height from its padding and children.

from.quote: AppBar derives its height from its public padding and children.

placementAdvice.text: At up to 360px of content width, one focused action leaves room; longer titles or extra actions compete with the side slots.

from.quote: At up to 360px of content width, one focused action leaves room; longer titles or extra actions compete with the side slots.

placementAdvice.text: Let the product flow own navigation state: AppBar presents the current destination and invokes the child actions the flow supplies.

from.quote: The product flow owns navigation state.

configuration.text: Choose the page relationship first: the main page type gives a view its identity.

from.quote: MainPage gives a view its identity.

configuration.text: Use the sub page type for a child destination: it supplies a back relationship and centers its title independently from the side slots.

from.quote: SubPage supplies a back relationship and centers its title independently from the side slots.

configuration.text: Do not give a detail view the main page identity: JioDot and an empty middle slot describe a top-level destination, not a child page.

from.quote: JioDot and an empty middle slot describe a top-level destination, not a child page.

configuration.text: For a main page, the published story pairs JioDot with low-emphasis add and Avatar actions and leaves the middle slot empty.

from.quote: The published MainPage story pairs JioDot with low-emphasis add and Avatar actions and leaves the middle slot empty.

configuration.text: A main page has no default leading node: pass JioDot, or another mark, in leadingSlot.
On a sub page, supply an accessible back action: an IconButton with a Go back label in leadingSlot, so the leading action has a clear accessible name.

from.quote: The guide supplies a public IconButton with a Go back label so the leading action has a clear accessible name.

configuration.text: The sub page middle slot is 192 px wide by default; middleSlotWidth changes it and has no effect on a main page.
Keep actions focused: one low-emphasis action leaves the destination and the next step easy to scan.

from.quote: One low-emphasis action leaves the destination and the next step easy to scan.

configuration.text: Do not overcrowd the actions slot: every extra control competes with the few actions that support the current task.

from.quote: Every extra control competes with the few actions that support the current task.

configuration.text: Configure the bar type and slots, then configure availability on the child action that needs it: AppBar owns the arrangement, and its IconButton children own enabled and disabled feedback.

from.quote: Configure the bar type and slots, then configure availability on the public child action that needs it.

configuration.text: Set modes on AppBar: it resolves its own modes with Context2 AppBar and cascades the result to its direct slot children.

from.quote: AppBar resolves its own modes with `Context2=AppBar` and cascades the resulting mode object to direct slot children.

rules.text: Use the bar to orient people. Keep its title short and its actions focused.

from.quote: Use the bar to orient people. Keep its title short and its actions focused.

rules.text: Keep the title short: use the page name people need to recognize, then move supporting detail into the page body.

from.quote: Use the page name people need to recognize, then move supporting detail into the page body.

rules.text: Do not put the page brief inside the bar: the centered slot clips extra words when a title carries the whole page brief.

from.quote: The centered slot clips extra words when a title carries the whole page brief.

rules.text: Show only the few actions that help someone complete the current task.

from.quote: Show only the few actions that help someone complete the current task.

rules.text: Each action should support the page people are on and remain understandable from its accessible label.

from.quote: Each action should support the page they are on and remain understandable from its accessible label.

states.when: The page has a useful next action: its IconButton in the actions slot is enabled.

from.quote: Use the actions slot when the page has a useful next action.

states.when: A child action is temporarily unavailable: disable that child IconButton.

from.quote: Disable a child IconButton when its action is temporarily unavailable.

accessibility.text: On a sub page, supply a named back action in leadingSlot, such as an IconButton with accessibilityLabel “Go back”: the package default back arrow has no accessible name.

from.quote: the guide also supplies a named public back action because the package default has no accessible name.

accessibility.text: Name icon actions with the IconButton accessibilityLabel so icon-only controls remain discoverable.

from.quote: Use the public IconButton accessibilityLabel so icon-only controls remain discoverable.

doDont.why: The centered slot clips extra words when a title carries the whole page brief.

from.quote: Keep the destination concise

doDont.why: Every extra control competes with the few actions that support the current task.

from.quote: Keep actions focused

doDont.do: Use SubPage for a child destination
doDont.dont: Use MainPage identity for a detail view
doDont.why: JioDot and an empty middle slot describe a top-level destination, not a child page.

from.quote: Use SubPage for a child destination

examples.purpose: A child destination: a named Go back action, a short centered title, and one low-emphasis action.
examples.jsx:
<AppBar
  type="SubPage"
  modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', Context2: 'AppBar', 'Page type': 'SubPage' }}
  leadingSlot={
    <IconButton
      iconName="ic_arrow_back"
      accessibilityLabel="Go back"
      onPress={() => {}}
      modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', Context2: 'AppBar', 'Page type': 'SubPage' }}
    />
  }
  middleSlot={
    <Text numberOfLines={1} modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', Context2: 'AppBar', 'Page type': 'SubPage' }}>
      Payment details
    </Text>
  }
  actionsSlot={
    <IconButton
      iconName="ic_more_horizontal"
      accessibilityLabel="More options"
      onPress={() => {}}
      modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', Context2: 'AppBar', 'Page type': 'SubPage', Emphasis: 'Low' }}
    />
  }
/>

from.quote: The supplied Go back action makes the relationship to the parent page explicit.

examples.purpose: A top-level destination: JioDot in the leading slot, low-emphasis add and Avatar actions, and an empty middle slot.
examples.jsx:
<AppBar
  type="MainPage"
  modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', Context2: 'AppBar', 'Page type': 'MainPage' }}
  leadingSlot={<JioDot modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', Context2: 'AppBar', 'Page type': 'MainPage' }} />}
  actionsSlot={[
    <IconButton
      key="add"
      iconName="ic_add"
      accessibilityLabel="Add item"
      onPress={() => {}}
      modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', Context2: 'AppBar', 'Page type': 'MainPage', Emphasis: 'Low' }}
    />,
    <Avatar key="avatar" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', Context2: 'AppBar', 'Page type': 'MainPage' }} />,
  ]}
/>

from.quote: The published MainPage story pairs JioDot with low-emphasis add and Avatar actions and leaves the middle slot empty.

props.name: type
props.description: Figma's main page variant includes the JioDot mark; the package makes JioDot opt-in through leadingSlot. Declared: Type of the App Bar. - `MainPage`: Taller bar; no default leading (pass `JioDot` or your logo via `leadingSlot`). - `SubPage`: Shorter bar with default back arrow and centered middle slot. Default "MainPage", from the component source.

props.name: leadingSlot
props.description: On a sub page, omitting leadingSlot gives a default back arrow whose button has no accessible name; a main page has no default leading node. Declared: Slot for the leading element. Defaults: - MainPage: none (opt in with `<JioDot />` or any custom node) - SubPage: Back `NavArrow`.

props.name: middleSlot
props.description: Slot for the middle content. Often used for a page title on SubPage. On `SubPage` this is rendered as an absolutely-centered box (Figma "slot wrap"): it stays centered regardless of leading/actions width, and content fills/shrinks within {@link middleSlotWidth}.

props.name: middleSlotWidth
props.description: Defaults to 192; the sub page middle is centered in an absolute overlay with 21px horizontal inner padding and clips overflow. Declared: Width of the centered `SubPage` middle slot, in px. Defaults to the Figma value (192). Has no effect on `MainPage`. Default 192, from the component source.

props.name: actionsSlot
props.description: Slot for the actions on the right (IconButtons, Avatar, etc.).

props.name: modes
props.description: AppBar resolves its own modes with Context2=AppBar and cascades the resulting mode object to its direct slot children. Declared: Token modes to override.

props.name: onLeadingPress
props.description: Callback for the default SubPage leading back arrow.

props.name: ...Omit<React.ComponentProps<typeof View>, 'style' | 'accessibilityRole' | 'accessibilityLabel' | 'accessibilityHint'>
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

gaps.text: The default sub page back arrow has no accessible name: its button passes no accessibilityLabel.
Figma's main page shows the JioDot mark; the package renders none unless leadingSlot is given JioDot.
Figma's fixed reference heights (main page 68 px, sub page 52 px) are not fixed in code: the bar's height comes from its padding plus its children.
A long sub page title is constrained by the centered 192px middle box and clips or truncates.
